description:
We are looking for a talented Service Information and Training Development Specialist to join our team in Eaton Cummins Joint Venture (ECJV): Eaton Cummins Automated Transmission Technologies in Galesburg, MI.    

 This role is an employee of the Eaton Cummins Joint Venture (ECJV): Eaton Cummins Automated Transmission Technologies. Internal candidates are defined as employees of the ECJV.   

 In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:   

 
 
 Mechatronics & Controls Engineering 
 Design and apply mechatronic systems, electronic hardware, and open/closed-loop control architectures that enable robust, high-performing product functionality. 


 
 System Integration & Optimization 
 Integrate mechanical, electrical, software, and control subsystems to optimize product performance, reliability, quality, and customer value while resolving technical challenges efficiently. 


 
 Requirements & Systems Engineering 
 Translate stakeholder needs into clear, verifiable system requirements, establish acceptance criteria, and manage requirements throughout the product lifecycle. 


 
 Modeling, Simulation & Validation 
 Leverage analytical tools, simulation methods, and validation testing to evaluate product capabilities, reduce technical risk, and support data-driven design decisions. 


 
 Reliability & Failure Prevention 
 Identify potential failure modes, analyze system interactions, and implement proactive solutions that enhance product durability, reliability, and overall performance. 


 
 Problem Solving & Data Analytics 
 Apply structured problem-solving, statistical methods, and root cause analysis to resolve product issues, improve outcomes, and prevent recurring problems. 


 
 Cross-Functional Product Development 
 Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, and business stakeholders to execute product development activities, drive design reviews, and ensure successful project delivery. 


 
 Technical Leadership & Knowledge Sharing 
 Communicate complex technical information effectively, develop comprehensive documentation, support continuous improvement, and foster an inclusive environment that values diverse perspectives. 


 
 To be successful in this role, you will need the following:   
 Jazz Engineering & Product Development Experience 
 Experience working within the Jazz engineering environment, including requirements management, change request processes, and product verification & validation (V&V) activities. 

 Customer-Focused Systems Engineering 
 Ability to serve as a key technical interface between customers and engineering teams, ensuring successful transmission integration from requirements definition through implementation. 

 Field Investigation & Root Cause Analysis 
 Experience leading customer field investigations, analyzing data, troubleshooting complex technical issues, and identifying effective corrective actions. 

 Transmission Integration Expertise 
 Knowledge of transmission integration principles and experience supporting system-level functionality, performance, and customer requirements. 

 Requirements & Change Management 
 Demonstrated ability to manage system requirements, evaluate design changes, and assess impacts to product performance, scope, and timelines. 

 Product Growth & Program Support 
 Experience supporting product growth initiatives, new applications, and engineering projects while serving as the primary systems engineering point of contact. 

 Cross-Functional Collaboration 
 Proven ability to work effectively across engineering, product, manufacturing, and customer-facing teams to drive successful project outcomes. 

 Technical Communication & Problem Solving 
 Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills with the ability to present technical findings, influence decisions, and deliver practical solutions to customers and stakeholders. 

   
 Education, Licenses, Certifications:  
 College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.  

 Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles. 

 This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.   

 Experience:  
 Entry level/Early career professional. Preferred candidates would have relevant experience working in either a temporary student employment environment (intern, co-op, or other extracurricular team activities) or as an early career professional in a relevant technical discipline area. Knowledge of MS Office tools is also preferred 

 Systems and product engineering experience with a strong focus on mechatronic systems, transmission controls, and control module development .  
 Proficiency with CANape, CANalyzer, MATLAB, and Simulink for system development, calibration, analysis, and validation.  
 Strong understanding of J1939 data link communications and vehicle network integration.  
 Experience working within the Jazz engineering environment , including requirements management, change control, and verification & validation (V&V) processes.  
 Demonstrated success leading customer field investigations , performing data analysis, troubleshooting complex issues, identifying root causes, and driving effective corrective actions.  
 Ability to work directly with customers on transmission integration projects , translating requirements into successful system implementation and deployment.  
 Experience supporting new product development and product growth initiatives , serving as the primary systems engineering interface across cross-functional teams.  
 Strong communication, collaboration, and technical leadership skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and drive engineering solutions from concept through production support. 
 Compensation and Benefits   
 The final salary offer will be determined after considering relevant factors, including a candidate’s qualifications and experience, where appropriate.  
 Additional benefits vary between locations and include options such as our 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan, Medical/Dental/Life Insurance, Health Savings Account, Domestic Partners Coverage and a full complement of personal and professional benefits.  

Cummins is an equal opportunity employer. Our policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified persons without regard to race, sex, color, disability, national origin, age, religion, union affiliation, sexual orientation, veteran status, citizenship, gender identity, or other status protected by law.
